Citrine Prime Access
Wake up flawless on September 23.
Posted On 2026-09-04 07:54:00
Tweet

Shine on with a diamond’s spellbinding purpose once Citrine Prime enters Prime Access on September 23! Lavish Orokin gold complements every perfect cut of this jeweled bastion’s signature Prime Weapons and exclusive Prime Accessories, instilling those fortunate enough to witness her luminescence with unshakeable resolve.

Make your Arsenal shimmer with instant access and get the Prime items of your choice by selecting from the Weapons, Prime, Complete and Accessories Packs (depending on your platform and preferences). Additionally, you can earn Citrine Prime and her signature Prime Weapons in-game by collecting and cracking-open Void Relics!

Citrine Prime Access includes:

Citrine Prime

The crystalline citadel ascends. Citrine Prime captivates with refined radiance, her brilliant gems set within the finest gold filigree.

Steflos Prime

This rose has gilded thorns. Deal death from even further afar with Citrine Prime’s signature shotgun.

Corufell Prime

Corufell Prime’s golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.

Citrine Prime Accessories

  • Sphatika Prime Syandana
  • Alumeti Prime Sugatra
  • Prismatic Gem Prime Decoration
  • Spinele Prime Facial Accessory
  • Spinele Prime Earpiece
  • Spinele Prime Oculus

Note: There’s no better value than with the Citrine Prime Access Complete Pack, which includes the Citrine Prime Warframe, her Prime Weapons and Accessories, as well as additional Platinum.

What are Primes?

When you require the finest and most powerful armaments, only Primes will do. Exquisitely gilded, every Prime Warframe, Weapon and item exists in its purest form — just as the Orokin intended.
